run_analyze_results_cli: run the CLI tool to evaluate detection results and save top/bottom mAP images to a directory
run_bbox_map_eval: run bbox_map_eval to compute the average mAP across IoU thresholds 0.5 to 0.95 for a single image
create_ResultVisualizer: create a ResultVisualizer instance to display and save object detection evaluation results with configurable show and wait options
run_evaluate_and_show: run evaluate_and_show to rank detection results by mAP and save the best and worst topk images
run_save_image_gts_results: run _save_image_gts_results to render and save ground truth and detected bounding boxes with mAP scores as filenames
